text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
"Man, Almond Eye is way too strong! Think 
she might conquer the Grand Prix next 
year?"

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
"Couldn't she aim for the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe? She's definitely an Umamusume 
worthy of carrying Japan on her 
shoulders!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(Inspire visions of the future like no one 
else.)

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"I heard she's taking a break for this 
period. Year-end without Ai-chan, huh~"

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"It's so I can shine even brighter next 
year! I've been working suuuuper hard all 
year, after all!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(Bathe in the spotlight more than anyone 
else.)

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text:
"Next time Almond Eye races, I want to go 
to the track! I want to see her in 
person!"

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text:
Aah, Ai-chan merch! I should buy some for 
my little sister too!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(The readers expect more from you than 
anyone else.)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Now this is what a true protagonist looks 
like...

The entire world was dyed in the colors of 
Almond Eye.

"To the point where rumors have already 
begun swirling that she's a shoo-in for 
this year's Horse Girl of the Year."
(Rattle...)

The door rattled, then fell silent without 
opening. That hushed, breath-bated quiet 
made me involuntarily stand up.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I knew it—
choice_data_list: —Kiseki!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Kh, Trainer-san...
choice_data_list: What's the matter? Come inside.
What's wrong? Come on inside.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, no. Um...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
choice_data_list: …It's okay, come here.

text_block_list.text:
I pour hot water from the electric kettle 
and hand her a cup of soup.
choice_data_list:
You can do it once you've calmed down, so 
take your time.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...I'm sorry.
choice_data_list: ...Take your time, there's no rush.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I wasn't the main character...!

I hold her trembling hands as she closes 
her eyes, and gently place the glass on 
the adjacent table.

Her fingertips were cold enough to freeze, 
and tears were spilling steadily from her 
eyes.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
To begin with, as a main character, I was 
warped from the start.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, a protagonist thinking 'I want to 
be the protagonist' sounds weird! A goal 
like that is just—"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—Even though it's basically admitting that 
I'm not the protagonist...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The main character of a manga is a girl 
just like Ai-chan!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Charge straight ahead, driven by the pure 
desire to win! To become that kind of 
hero—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
A fake protagonist could never hope to 
match the real protagonist.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: There's no way I can...!
choice_data_list:
...That's not true. There's no way you're 
a fake.

...That's not true. There's no way you're 
an impostor.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh... But still! Even if I take on the 
"battle for the strongest" at the 
Takarazuka, or win the Tenno Sho (Autumn)!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't get everyone as excited as 
Ai-chan could! I couldn't become the 
protagonist people wished for like she 
did!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The protagonist the world is looking for 
is—
choice_data_list:
You can't measure whether someone's a main 
character by something like that!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Why... *sob*...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: How can you be so sure of that...!
choice_data_list:
In that case... what's a main character, 
anyway?
In that case... what is a protagonist?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...The protagonist is...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
They're the person who moves the story, 
livens it up, and stands at the very heart 
of the tale...!
choice_data_list:
What does it even mean to hype people up, 
to be entertaining?

To hype people up, to be entertaining... 
what does that even mean?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...It's about taking on challenges!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Doing something you couldn't normally do, 
like in a drama. Taking on a challenge 
that feels totally impossible...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Even against an opponent you can never 
beat, you can still win... that's what...!
choice_data_list:
It's exactly the same as our current 
situation.
It's just like our situation right now.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
choice_data_list:
A real protagonist beats opponents they 
supposedly can't beat.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh... No way...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You're just nitpicking. Even though a day 
where I win might never come.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
For a flawed, imperfect protagonist to 
beat a picture-perfect one is so 
exceptionally rare! That's—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Such an intriguing turn of events...—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh, ...She looks just like... the main 
character...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I look... just like a main character...!
choice_data_list:
Yeah, the main character makes miracles 
happen!

That's right, the protagonist makes 
miracles happen!

text_block_list.text:
Having an opponent to overcome gives 
Kiseki the protagonist's advantage over 
Almond Eye.
—Kiseki is the protagonist.
choice_data_list: I'm getting excited.
I'm getting excited.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...U-Ugh... ...That's not fair...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That's not fair! Not fair! That's way too 
unfair! If you say something like that, I—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...I want to win—!
choice_data_list: I want to win with you too.
I want to win with you too.

text_block_list.text:
The protagonist right before my eyes 
doesn't falter in her story. Even if she's 
covered in mud, even if living that way is 
painful.

With her eyes brimming with hope and 
frustration, she will stand up on her own 
two feet. To continue the story along that 
very path.
choice_data_list: Your story isn't over yet.
Your story isn't over yet.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...U-Ughhh... Uuuuggghhh...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Waaaaaaahhhh~~...!!

Kiseki once again channels the bitter 
frustration of defeat into heavy tears.

And so, giving it everything. Absolutely 
everything—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Say that one more time, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I am the protagonist.
choice_data_list: ...You are the main character.
...You're the protagonist.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...More! Please!!
choice_data_list:
You're the protagonist who makes miracles 
happen!!!

You are the protagonist who makes miracles 
happen!!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That's right! An Umamusume worthy of being 
the main protagonist!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Because I'm not perfect, I'll beat that 
perfect girl and become the greatest 
protagonist ever!

Kiseki vigorously gulps down the cup of 
soup left on the table.

And she let out a sharp breath, and 
breathed in—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer. Let us make sure to win the 
final leg of the Autumn Senior Triple 
Crown, the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"If I can't even do that much, there's no 
way I can ever beat Ai-chan."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I won't lose anymore. —Not until I beat 
Ai-chan.
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's go for the win! Kiseki!
Yeah, let's go win this! Kiseki!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —Yes!!

As long as the protagonist keeps moving 
forward, her story will go on.

—As long as she doesn't stop walking, 
always.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
—Kh! I see, I see! Kiseki, you're running 
in the Arima Kinen too?!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Heheh... I'm not gonna lose either, you 
know!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh, ...Like I'd ever back down...! 
.........I want to win too, damn it...!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
—Thank goodness. We get a rematch, 
Kiseki-san.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
......I have no intention of letting this 
be the end for me either!

As long as there are those who keep 
challenging, as long as there are those 
who keep moving forward.
The "story" never ends.
